notes.title: Next Fest Game Stream
notes.content: We are starting a game stream to show case Catastrophe and advertising the time of our developer live streams. We hope you enjoy what you see and please go try the game out for yourselves. We are still very much in early development. The game is a work in progress and we are pleased with where we are currently at. Again we hope you are pleased with it.

notes.title: Steam Next Fest June 2022 Game Demo
notes.content:
[b]STEAM NEXT FEST JUNE 2022 Game Demo[/b1]

10 years ago I started this journey to get into game development. I went to college for Game Art and Animation. I spent a couple of years after that learning how to program inside unreal and learning that it's almost impossible to build a game as a solo developer. A few years ago I started working on building up a team. We spent the last few years getting ready for a major project by working on several small games and going through code from the Unreal Marketplace. We wanted to make sure that we were ready before we committed to a larger project. We've only spent the last few months working on Catastrophe and we still have a long road ahead of us. On Sunday we released our first game demo out into the public for Steam Next Fest June 2022. We hope that you enjoy the game demo. We'll be Live Streaming and talking about where we are going from here in terms of game features changes we already have planned. We look forward to you stopping by the steam. We post times and dates in a few short hours on when those Streams will be happening.
